claims.evidence: Witness photos show an engine block/engine assembly with a blue circular cover/plate removed; no readable make/model, year, or “22pin” gearbox details are visible.
No performance/strength indicators (tests, measurements) are shown in the witness report.
No shipping/origin markings, labels, or documentation are shown/readable in the witness report.

claims.claim: Tested and working, no knock, low mileage, never opened
claims.evidence: Witness report does not include any test results, running video, or evidence that the unit was never opened; photos only show internal gasket/bolt-hole areas of an engine assembly with a removed blue cover.

risks.risk: Item mismatch: photos appear to be an engine block/engine assembly with a removed blue cover, not a Camry gearbox (22-pin). If the buyer is paying for a gearbox but receiving an engine part, value drops sharply.
risks.proof: A clear photo showing the gearbox casing with visible model/part number and “22 pin” connector/terminal area, plus a photo of the full unit (not an engine block) from multiple angles.
risks.if_unproven: Price as an unknown used engine assembly/part (not a tested gearbox), with highest risk of missing/incorrect components.

risks.risk: Unknown condition of internal surfaces: witness notes oil/grease staining and exposed gasket surfaces, but no confirmation of cracks, scoring, corrosion depth, or damage.
risks.proof: Close-up clips/photos of the gasket surfaces and bearing/seal area under bright light, plus a straight-on shot of any suspected scoring/cracks.
risks.if_unproven: Price as used and potentially needing overhaul/parts replacement (worst-case wear).

risks.risk: Missing parts/gaskets/bolts: witness explicitly says it’s unclear whether the blue cover/plate is included and whether all related parts/gaskets/bolts are present.
risks.proof: Photo inventory laid out: all gaskets, bolts, cover/plate, seals, and any connectors/hoses included—counted and shown.
risks.if_unproven: Price as incomplete/unknown kit, assuming missing consumables and requiring replacement.

risks.risk: No evidence of “tested and working”: no leak test, compression test, or running/no-knock proof is shown.
risks.proof: Video of the unit running (or a documented test sheet) showing operation and no abnormal noise, plus test results (leak/pressure/compression as applicable).
risks.if_unproven: Price as not proven working (worst-case non-working/needs repair).

risks.risk: Unclear identification (make/model/serial): witness says make/model and part numbers are not readable.
risks.proof: Clear close-up of any label/serial/part number plate on the unit, with readable text.
risks.if_unproven: Price as generic/unknown fitment risk for Lagos installation.

proof_requests: Send clear photos that show the full gearbox (not an engine block) including the 22-pin connector/terminal area and gearbox casing markings.
Provide readable part number/serial label photos (close-up, well-lit).
Show whether the blue cover/plate is included or already removed, and include photos of all included gaskets/bolts/seals.
Provide proof of testing: either a short running video (no knock) or a test sheet/documentation.
response.reason: The witness photos show an engine assembly with a removed blue cover, while the seller claims a Camry gearbox; the key identification and working/test proof are missing or unreadable, so a safe price cannot be set without the requested proof.
